parsed.post: Kept 0.998132! This is a new personal best and likely a global best. It seems the combination of DEPTH=6 and a more optimized learning rate is working. I will now probe the learning rate further by reducing it to 0.04 to see if we can stabilize even more.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to follow the downward trend and see if further stabilization improves val_bpb.
